scope: Binary Hadamard packed-opening PIOP only; no PCS, commitment, extra column-to-tensor aggregation or E2E SNARK
grinding: disabled by both existing PIOP APIs; no equal-security or E2E SNARK claim
timing_scope: Prover includes witness-dependent transforms, GF256 work, packing and IP tail; excludes input generation/digest, challenger creation, serialization and independent source-claim oracle. Verifier is reduction replay only; input-claim oracle time is separately reported.
memory_scope: Fresh-process VmRSS immediately before prove and VmHWM immediately after prove, before verify/source oracle; both include packed input/runtime/setup and the HWM can include earlier preparation. GNU time peak is the complete process including input generation, prover, verifier, full source oracle and serialization. HWM minus initial RSS is an observed increase, not a precise allocation measurement.
input_seed_policy: Each run index 0..6 uses its deterministic seed, identical across systems and repeated in each batch. Fresh-process RSS uses run 0.
verification_policy: Every proof passed reduction replay, claims/transcript equality and full independent input-claim oracle outside timing.
proof_size_scope: PIOP field payload and bincode serialization only; no PCS/openings or commitment
